progression_rules: No completion from docs, stubs, test counts, or green compilation alone.
Research one dependency-ready gap, reproduce or specify a failure, then implement one bounded packet.
Keep native and independent acceptance gates; staged repairs are not auto-merged.
Record source SHA, commands, exits, versions, files, hashes, and deferred local checks.
For pull_request CI, distinguish source association from GitHub's synthetic integration merge and tested base when recording final integration evidence.
Pin the post-evidence receipt head in PR metadata/checkpoint rather than creating an infinite self-referential evidence commit chain.
Do not shrink an earlier admitted native acceptance matrix without explicit approved scope change.
No second local scheduler, local process control, R0 execution, publication, release, merge, dependency, or graphics-API change from this packet.
Do not remove unresolved capability rows or catalogue gaps to make parity easier.
